reason: I learn from YouTube and TikTok for free and it works fine for me. There are a hundred Thai videos each for green curry, tom yum and pad see ew, so I might open the free kaprao once, but I'm not paying 99 baht every month for recipes I can watch for nothing.
objection: Every dish they list is already free on YouTube from Thai cooks I already follow, so why pay every month? 99 baht is about two plates of kaprao from the stall downstairs.
would_change_my_mind: If the free part let me cook something I actually get wrong from videos, like green curry, and the chef fixed my mistake while I was cooking. Then I'd see it does something a video can't.
